generate3dCube.description: Creates a cuboid geometry in the cache under a unique object_id, for use in a collision node.

collision.title: Collision
collision.description: Clash detection between cached geometries. Tests every A reference against every B reference (cartesian product). Bind list_a / list_b from upstream nodes; an unbound side falls back to the whole model.
collision.modeHelp: Boolean reports which pairs collide. Intersection mesh additionally caches each overlap under a deterministic key.

bcfOutput.title: BCF Output
bcfOutput.description: Turn LOI-Check failures into a BCF 3.0 file. Connect the {elements} output of an LOI-Check node.
bcfOutput.autoModeInfo: the standard templates are applied automatically for every LOI-Check scenario. Switch to manual mode to write your own title and description templates.

loiCheck.title: LOI-Check
loiCheck.description: Check IFC property values against expected target values. Add one rule per row in the table below.
loiCheck.clickAddRow: Click Add Row to start defining a property check.
loiCheck.decimalTooltip: Decimal values use a point: e.g. 0.25. A comma is not accepted.

getProperty.title: Get Property
getProperty.description: Read property values from IFC entities. Define which properties to read in the table below.
getProperty.outputModeHint: Output granularity: 'Per explicit element' (Output structured on the level of explicit individual elements), 'Per element class' (Output structured on the level of element classes), or 'Without element class distinction' (Output without distinction of element classes).

ifcElementFilter.title: IfcElementFilter
ifcElementFilter.description: Filter IFC entities by class, PredefinedType, attributes, and PropertySets.
ifcElementFilter.clickAddRow: Click Add Filter Row to start filtering.

measurement.title: Measurement
measurement.description: Compute geometric measurements (volume, surface area, projected area, component height, minimum distance between elements, distance to reference) of IFC elements or cached geometries.
measurement.measurementTypeHelp: Computes volume, surface area, projected area, component height, minimum distance between elements (List A × List B pattern), and distance to reference (point/plane).
measurement.listBWarning: List B is only used for "Minimum Distance Between Elements" mode and will be ignored.
measurement.projectionNormalHelp: Normal vector for the projection plane. Default [0,0,1] computes footprint (top-down view).
measurement.directionHelp: Direction vector for extent computation. Default [0,0,1] computes vertical height.
measurement.referenceTypeHelp: Choose between distance to a reference point or perpendicular distance to a reference plane.
measurement.referencePointHelp: Coordinates [x, y, z] of the reference point (or plane origin).
measurement.planeNormalHelp: Normal vector of the reference plane. Default [0,0,1] is the XY plane.
